_comment: Bone map: Quaternius 'LowPoly Animated Monsters' Skeleton rig -> the shared
This rig is a worked example of why the map exists: the artist built the arms
by duplicating the leg chains, so they arrive named L.UpperLeg.001 and
L.DownLeg.001. Their bone positions (heads at Z~1.8, extending sideways)
identify them as arms. Renaming is the only way animation from another
character can ever drive this one.
The rig has no shoulder, hand, foot or toe bones, so four bones that
SkeletonProfileHumanoid marks required are absent. The converter reports
every unmapped bone; a Godot BoneMap leaves the missing entries empty.
Head: Head
